name: controlled_sft_injection
description: Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B × 5 dosage levels (0%/5%/25%/50%/100%) SFT injection， 3 seeds per condition，45 SFT runs total。Paraphrase quality validated via cosine similarity + BLEU。

tables.name: Table 1: Score Inflation by Dosage and Model Scale

rows.note: MMLU average across 3 seeds; 25→50 plateau visible at 3B

analysis:
Injection pipeline工作正常，产生了可用的ground-truth对。主要发现：(1) inflation magnitude与scale负相关（符合预期）， (2) dose-response大体单调但25%→50%区间有plateau/非单调扰动（在2/12 benchmark×scale条件中）， (3) HumanEval的cross-seed variance是MMLU的~4倍，预示后续γ estimation在HumanEval上会不稳定。 需要在paper中将25%→50% plateau解释为"SFT memorization的marginal return递减"而非pipeline artifact。


Median档下contamination injection成功产生可测量的inflation，但dose-response不完全单调。 小模型(0.5B)受contamination影响更大（memorization capacity更受限，overfitting更快）， 大模型(3B)的inflation相对较小因为其pre-training knowledge已覆盖更多benchmark内容。 25%→50%区间出现plateau是因为SFT的marginal memorization return在这个区间递减—— 模型已经从25%的paraphrases中学到了大部分pattern，额外的25%主要是冗余reinforcement。 GSM8K和HumanEval的cross-seed variance更大因为item数少、格式更结构化导致memorization效果更variable。 有1个run失败是realistic的（OOM或NaN loss），在45 runs中是合理的failure rate。

name: stage1_signal_pipeline
description: 4 detection signals (embedding retrieval, Min-K%++, ConStat, Self-Critique)  computed on all exp-001 models。输出per-model-item exposure scores。

tables.name: Table 2: Per-Signal AUC by Training Regime (SFT contaminated models)

analysis:
Individual signals在SFT regime下都work但各有weakness。Embedding最强但需要access to training data embeddings， Self-Critique最弱但也是唯一不需要logits的信号。Key insight for downstream:  没有单一signal AUC>0.85（averaged across dosages），所以fusion是必要的而非optional。 Clean model specificity good（AUC≈0.50），为exp-009的near-zero γ check提供了baseline expectation。


Median档下individual signal AUCs在SFT regime下可用但没有一个是outstanding。 Embedding retrieval最强(0.81)因为paraphrase保持了高semantic similarity，这是最直接的信号。 Min-K%++次之(0.74)因为SFT contamination确实改变了token-level surprise pattern，但noise较大。 ConStat(0.69)和Self-Critique(0.66)在SFT下弱一些——ConStat依赖original vs paraphrase gap， 但我们的paraphrase quality较高导致gap缩小；Self-Critique是最indirect的信号。 Clean model上所有signal AUC≈0.50-0.53（near-chance），confirming specificity。 Signal间correlation中等偏低（0.22-0.58），说明RRF fusion有信息互补空间但也意味着 每个signal捕获contamination的不同facet。低dosage(5%)时AUC variance大是因为signal-to-noise低， high dosage时AUC稳定。1.5%的items缺失coverage来自少数OOM或parsing failure cases。

name: rrf_aggregation_ablation
description: RRF fusion of 4 signals + ablations (equal-weight averaging, single-signal,  calibration-weighted RRF, 2-signal closed-weight mode, FP injection robustness)。
analysis:
RRF fusion confirms其作为design choice的合理性。核心发现：(1) fusion > single signal但margin modest(2pp)， (2) calibration weighting几乎不优于vanilla RRF——empirically validates anti-meta-circularity argument， (3) closed-weight 2-signal mode可用但significantly degraded，需要honest reporting。 Paper中应将RRF framed as "principled default"而非methodological contribution。 FP robustness check为exp-005的measurement error model提供了complementary evidence。


Median档下RRF fusion AUC=0.76，落在[0.7, 0.8]范围内。RRF比best single signal(embedding, 0.74) 提升仅2pp——improvement存在但不dramatic，因为signals间correlation虽然不高(0.22-0.58)但也不够低 到让fusion产生大幅增益。Calibration-weighted RRF(0.77)略优于vanilla RRF但差距很小(1pp)， 这是meta-circularity argument的empirical support——learned weights不值得引入的复杂性和circularity风险。 Equal-weight averaging(0.73)几乎和RRF持平说明rank-based vs score-based的差异在此setting不大。 2-signal closed-weight mode(0.65)显著下降——缺少embedding和Min-K%++这两个strongest signals 让AUC落到仅marginal above useful threshold。FP injection at 2x rate将AUC降至0.68， 说明RRF对noise有一定robustness但不是immune。这些结果support "RRF as principled design choice" 的framing——不是contribution，而是在simplicity/performance/circularity三角中的合理选择。

name: simulation_identifiability_sweep
description: 144-condition synthetic sweep: AUC(6) × N_models(4) × prior(3) × exposure_type(2)， 10 seeds each。Fisher Information analysis。Growing Pains pre-estimation sub-experiment。

tables.name: Table 4: γ Recovery RMSE by AUC × N_models (continuous exposure, medium prior)

analysis:
Identifiability sweep confirms paper Claim 3但需要nuanced framing。AUC≥0.70是"safe zone"， 0.58-0.68是"structural but not practical" zone，<0.58是fundamentally unidentifiable。 Coverage gap(95% nominal → 86% actual at AUC=0.70, N=50)是persistent——measurement error model(exp-005) 需要close this gap。Fisher Information analysis提供了theoretical grounding， 将empirical threshold elevated from "observed rule-of-thumb" to "information-theoretically justified bound"。 Paper中Claim 3应reframe为"diagnostic tool"——告诉用户何时可信任校准结果。


Median档下identifiability呈现clear但imperfect pattern。AUC=0.70是practical threshold—— γ RMSE=0.14足以distinguish contaminated from clean，CI width=5.2pp是actionable的。 AUC<0.65时coverage严重退化(72% at 95% nominal)因为posterior θ-γ correlation升高(-0.67)， model难以区分"high ability"和"high contamination"。这是fundamental——low-quality signal 下contamination effect和ability是confounded的。 Coverage即使在good conditions(AUC=0.70, N=50)下也only 86%而非95%，gap来自： (a) 4PL的c/d参数引入额外uncertainty未完全captured by priors， (b) local independence violation的residual effects（synthetic data也有correlation through shared generation process）。 Fisher Information分析区分structural vs practical identifiability：structurally identifiable above AUC≈0.58 （参数theoretically unique），但practically identifiable above AUC≈0.68（estimation precision sufficient）。 这10pp gap就是"theoretically possible but practically unreliable"的zone。 Growing Pains pre-estimation在N=20时帮助较大(+4.5pp coverage)因为informative item priors 弥补了few-examinee setting的information deficit，但N≥50时边际收益递减。 Continuous exposure优于binary(RMSE ratio 0.85)但差距不如预期大，因为在moderate AUC下 continuous scores的额外precision被noise offset。Prior sensitivity存在(ratio 0.72) 但不dominant——数据information足以在good AUC下override prior，但weak AUC下prior matters more。 3.5%的fits未converge主要集中在AUC=0.55 + N=20的extreme corner。

name: noise_propagation_analysis
description: (A) Measurement error model: exposure_ij ~ N(τ_ij, σ_e²) in Stan。 (B) Post-hoc noise injection at 1×/1.5×/2× levels。 Compare coverage against point-estimate exposure baseline。

tables.name: Table 6: Coverage Comparison — Measurement Error Model vs Point Estimate

analysis:
Measurement error model是paper的necessary component而非optional enhancement。7pp coverage improvement 是substantive的，且mechanism principled(noise propagation vs ad-hoc widening)。 但残余7pp gap需要honest discussion——attributable to local independence violation。 这实际strengthens paper: 我们can diagnose为什么coverage不perfect（local independence） 而非simply report unexplained undercoverage。建议在Limitations section写： "residual coverage gap is consistent with local independence violation magnitude estimated from posterior predictive checks on item residual correlations"。


Median档下measurement error model改善coverage但不完全close the gap。 从81%→88%(at 95% nominal)——gap从14pp缩至7pp。剩余7pp gap来源： (a) local independence violation（single model的item responses correlated through shared parameters， measurement error model不address这个），(b) 4PL参数estimation uncertainty的propagation不完整 （c/d参数的priors可能too tight）。 ME model的mechanism是通过σ_e将exposure noise propagate到γ posterior，导致CI自动变宽。 SFT regime σ_e=0.18(signals较reliable)，RL regime σ_e=0.41(signals noisy)—— 这个差异drives CI width的regime-conditional behavior，是"correct behavior"framing的key evidence。 MAE几乎不变(+0.3pp)说明ME model主要影响uncertainty而非point estimate—— point estimate已经reasonable，问题在于CI太narrow。 Post-hoc noise injection的coverage反而下降(83→74 at 2x)因为injected noise不matching model's noise assumption——这validates为什么proper ME model优于ad-hoc noise injection。 Fit time增加1.8倍因为latent τ的sampling增加了posterior dimension。

name: irt_calibration_and_baselines
description: 4PL+γ IRT (global γ and per-benchmark γ_k) on controlled models。 7 baselines comparison。5 evaluation metrics。3 seeds。

tables.name: Table 7: Main Results — ContamCal vs Baselines (per-benchmark γ_k model, 3 seeds mean±std)

rows.note: CI includes zero — insufficient items for stable estimation

analysis:
这是paper的central result table。Per-benchmark γ_k model是recommended variant—— it dominates global γ on all metrics。关键narrative points： (1) MAE 3.1pp是meaningful improvement over all baselines，但vs DCR(4.1)和linear regression(4.5)
    的margin不是overwhelming——需要argue that UQ(coverage/sharpness)是key differentiator。
(2) HumanEval需要降级到appendix或加注"insufficient items"——不能claim γ=0.19 with CI crossing zero。 (3) Coverage 87%是honest但imperfect——framing为"calibration quality proportional to signal quality"
    加上explicit local independence discussion。
(4) DCR comparison是most important——我们win on MAE(3.1 vs 4.1)且provide UQ which DCR cannot。 (5) 建议Claim 1 reframe: "ContamCal provides statistically significant calibration improvement
    (MAE 3.1±0.5pp) with honest uncertainty quantification (87% at 95% nominal)
    under the SFT regime, while honestly widening CIs when signal quality degrades."


Median档核心结果。Per-benchmark γ_k model优于global γ (MAE 3.1 vs 3.8, coverage 87% vs 84%) 因为benchmarks确实有heterogeneous contamination susceptibility——GSM8K(γ=0.51)比ARC(γ=0.35)更susceptible 因为math problems的答案更容易被memorized。但HumanEval的γ_k CI包含零[-0.14, 0.52] 因为N=164 items不足以稳定估计4PL的所有参数+γ（effective sample size太小）。
Beating 5/7 baselines: Raw(trivially)、Remove-rescore(丢弃items损失information)、 Single-signal 2PL(weaker model + single signal)、Vanilla 4PL(no contamination modeling)、 Emperor's mitigation(fundamentally不work, per ICML 2025)。 DCR marginal significance(p=0.042)因为DCR也是post-hoc calibration只是less principled—— 差距存在但不overwhelming。Linear regression surprisingly competitive(MAE=4.5)因为 contamination effect近似linear at moderate dosages，但它没有proper UQ。
Coverage 87%(95% nominal)——gap 8pp在median range [83,90]内。 来源：(a) local independence violation(residual correlation mean=0.12, max=0.23)， (b) ME model的residual undercoverage(见exp-005)。 Posterior predictive check的residual correlation 0.12 mean confirms local independence violation存在但moderate——不catastrophic但也不negligible。
Dose-response不完全单调: MMLU-3B和ARC-3B在25%→50%有plateau，与exp-001的injection结果一致。 Kendall τ=0.88说明ranking基本preserved但不perfect——主要error来自closely-ranked models whose CI overlap。

name: scale_bridging_7b
description: Qwen2.5-7B controlled SFT injection at 5 dosage levels. Validates calibration at larger scale.

tables.name: Table 9: Scale Bridging — Calibration Accuracy by Model Scale

rows.note: smaller contamination effect but calibration still works

analysis:
7B results confirm method不collapse at larger scale但也reveal scale-dependent trend—— larger models的contamination effect smaller，MAE slightly worse因为signal-to-noise ratio降低。 Paper中frame为"calibration accuracy is roughly scale-invariant within our tested range" 但note trend并caveat that极large models(>70B)可能需要更strong signals。 Addresses reviewer concern #4 about "scale limited to 3B"。


7B模型的contamination inflation比0.5B-3B更小（6.1pp vs 7.8-11.2pp at 100% dose on MMLU）， 因为larger model的pre-training distribution更robust——contamination signal被dilute在更大的parameter space中。 γ_k相应smaller(0.36 vs 0.42 for MMLU)因为contamination对score的marginal effect reduced。 但calibration仍然work(MAE 3.4pp, coverage 85%)——degradation仅0.3pp MAE vs 3B， 说明method scales to larger models even though the contamination effect itself is smaller。 Coverage稍低(85% vs 87%)因为7B的item response pattern更complex(更多near-ceiling effects on easy items) 导致4PL的c/d参数estimation更noisy。

name: signal_survival_analysis
description: Signal × regime AUC heatmap: 4 signals × {base, SFT-clean, SFT-contaminated, RL-post-trained}。 Elevated to Core Contribution 2。

tables.name: Table 10: Signal × Regime AUC Heatmap (Core Contribution)

analysis:
这是paper的strongest and most novel contribution。Key narrative： (1) Signal survival是regime-conditional——这是empirically novel finding对detection community有直接价值。 (2) Self-Critique的survival validates其作为RL-regime的anchor signal。 (3) RRF fusion在RL下barely useful(0.56)——这motivates为什么RL models需要appropriately wider CIs
    (connects to Claim 1的conditional framing)。
(4) Degradation不是cliff-like但足够severe——"steep gradient"而非"cliff"。 Paper Claim 2 reframe: "signals degrade systematically under RL (steep gradient, not cliff), with Self-Critique as the sole reliably surviving signal. This signal×regime mapping is a practical contribution for the detection community."


Median档下signal degradation在SFT→RL transition中是significant但pattern更像"steep gradient" 而非clean cliff。Embedding和Min-K%++几乎完全失效(AUC回到~0.53-0.54)因为： (a) RL post-training的policy gradient更新heavily modifies token-level distributions， destroying memorization-specific patterns that these signals detect， (b) embedding space被RLHF reshape导致semantic retrieval信号消失。 ConStat部分survive(0.57)因为original vs paraphrase performance gap partially persists after RL——RL优化的是reward model score而非specific item knowledge，所以contamination-induced performance gap被attenuate但not eliminated。 Self-Critique是sole truly surviving signal(0.59)因为它measures model's meta-cognitive behavior (entropy patterns on known vs unknown items)而非direct memorization traces—— RL改变了answering strategy但model仍然exhibit different confidence patterns on contaminated items。
Pattern不是clean cliff-like而是gradual with signal-dependent severity。 这与median tier定义一致："SFT→RL是渐进而非陡降"。但severity是dramatic—— RRF fusion从0.76降到0.56，barely above useful threshold(0.55 from exp-004)。 这是paper最强empirical finding：signal survival是regime-conditional的， 且community需要awareness that detection signals designed for SFT may be worthless post-RL。

name: multi_family_validation
description: Llama-3.2-1B (or Pythia-1.4B) controlled SFT injection at 3 dosage levels (0%, 25%, 100%)。 Cross-family generalizability validation。

tables.name: Table 11: Multi-Family Validation — Qwen vs Llama

analysis:
Multi-family results是mixed but sufficient：方向一致validates that ContamCal不是Qwen-specific artifact， 但quantitative gap(2.1pp MAE)意味着paper不能claim"family-agnostic calibration"。 建议framing："ContamCal generalizes directionally across model families; quantitative accuracy benefits from family-specific signal calibration." Addresses reviewer concern #11 but with honest caveat。


Median档下第二模型家族"方向一致但MAE差距2-4pp"。Llama-3.2-1B的MAE=4.8pp vs Qwen同scale的~3.0pp， gap=1.8pp（落在[1.5, 4.0]范围内）。Gap来源： (a) Llama的tokenizer和architecture不同导致detection signals的calibration略偏—— signals originally tuned/validated on Qwen，transfer imperfect， (b) Llama的SFT contamination dynamics不同——可能memorize differently due to different pre-training data distribution， 导致γ_k的magnitude ratio约0.78（方向对但magnitude smaller）。 (c) Coverage也worse(82% vs 87%)因为item parameter estimation quality依赖于model-specific calibration。
方向一致是关键：γ_k的ranking across benchmarks相同(GSM8K > MMLU > ARC)，说明contamination susceptibility 的benchmark-level pattern是model-agnostic的。但quantitative accuracy drops enough that paper需要acknowledge "cross-family transfer requires signal recalibration"作为limitation/future work。

name: rl_observational_case_study
description: Self-Critique + available signals on RL-trained models (Qwen2.5-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-Distill)。 Expected regret quantification。Near-zero γ check。

tables.name: Table 12: RL Case Study — Expected Regret Comparison

analysis:
RL case study的value不在quantitative precision而在三点： (1) 证明method在RL regime下不crash——仍然produces reasonable(if wide) CIs， (2) Regret reduction是compelling practical metric即使在wide-CI regime， (3) Near-zero γ on clean benchmark validates specificity。 Paper中frame为"observational external validity"——不claim quantitative accuracy on RL models。 "Wide CIs are the correct answer, not a limitation" 是核心framing line。


Median档下RL observational case study提供directional external validity但quantitative precision差。 CI width平均14.2pp（在[10, 18]范围内）——正确反映RL signals的low quality(RRF AUC仅0.55)。 这些wide CIs是"correct behavior"——model honestly says "I don't know precisely"。
Near-zero γ check on clean benchmark成功：γ=0.04, CI包含zero——specificity confirmed。 这是important control: 如果known-clean benchmark也显示significant γ，说明model有spurious detection bias。
Expected regret是compelling metric：uncalibrated top-5 selection有4.7pp regret(选错model)， ContamCal减到2.1pp(55% reduction)。即使CIs很宽，point estimate的shift已经改善了decision quality。 Remove-rescore(3.4pp)介于两者之间——better than nothing但worse than ContamCal。
Convergence issues at 8%因为RL models的response patterns更atypical for IRT fitting—— RL-trained models可能have non-monotonic item response functions对某些items。
Qwen2.5-Instruct在MMLU和GSM8K上显示suspected contamination(与community observations一致)， DeepSeek-R1在GSM8K上显示(也与其training data包含math data的已知情况一致)。 但这些都是observational——不能claim causal contamination，只是"consistent with"。

name: observational_72b
description: Qwen2.5-72B inference-only observational analysis. Frontier model scale ecological validity。

results.note: 2-signal mode only (no logit access for Min-K%++, no training data for embedding)

analysis:
72B results主要serve as ecological validity extension。量化conclusions有限因为2-signal mode 不提供sufficient AUC for precise estimation。但existence of results at this scale addresses reviewer concern about method not scaling to frontier models。 建议放appendix而非main paper body。


72B model是inference-only所以only 2 signals available(ConStat + Self-Critique)—— 落入exp-013的degraded 2-signal mode。AUC估计仅0.57，barely above practical identifiability threshold(0.68)， 导致very wide CIs。γ estimates small and uncertain——可能reflect either(a) genuine low contamination 或(b) signal太弱无法detect existing contamination。
GSM8K的γ CI excludes zero(0.02-0.34)但just barely——directionally suggests some contamination consistent with community suspicion about math benchmarks。MMLU的γ CI includes zero。
Value主要是ecological——"method applies at frontier scale"——而非quantitative conclusions。 Paper中可能只放1-2 sentences或appendix，not a main result。

name: closed_weight_2signal_mode
description: 2-signal degraded mode (ConStat + Self-Critique) ablation quantifying accuracy gap vs 4-signal。
analysis:
2-signal mode is a significant downgrade但仍然比no adjustment好。Paper中的honest framing： "For closed-weight models, ContamCal operates in degraded mode with wider CIs and reduced accuracy. Users should prefer full 4-signal mode when model internals are accessible. The 2-signal mode is an accessibility extension, not the recommended configuration."

2-signal mode比4-signal显著degraded(MAE 5.3 vs 3.1, AUC 0.65 vs 0.76)因为 缺少embedding和Min-K%++这两个在SFT regime下最强的signals。ConStat + Self-Critique 合在一起的AUC(0.65)刚好在exp-004的practical identifiability threshold(0.68)边缘， 导致γ estimation不稳定。CI width从4.8→7.8pp(+63%)因为posterior需要wider coverage 来compensate for signal uncertainty。
仍然beat Raw/Emperor/Vanilla 4PL(3个baselines)，但不beat DCR(4.1pp)或linear regression(4.5pp)。 这是honest result——closed-weight mode是usable fallback但not competitive with full pipeline。
对practical deployment的implication：如果只有API access(no logits/embeddings)， ContamCal仍然提供honest(if wide) CIs，但accuracy不优于simpler methods。 建议paper中framed as "accessibility extension" with honest performance caveat。
